title: policies/signing.json — the signature format and the cut-over commit of each repository
description: agent-fabric ADR-057 §5 rules 1, 3 and 5. tools/fabric/guards/signing_policy.py reads it for bootstrap and the checker and says the same shape again, so neither acts on a file lint refuses; tools/fabric/lint_rules/signing.py adds what a schema cannot say (each repository is one the registry names, no project twice).

default.description: The fleet default: a repository no entry names gets it, and bootstrap leaves its working copies as they are.

since.description: Always null: a cut-over commit belongs to one repository, so only an entry under repositories carries one.

repositories.description: owner/name, as one of the project's projects/registry.json remotes names it.

format.description: The one format git signs in there (gpg.format) and the one the checker admits.

since.description: The full sha on the default branch that ends the old signing: it and every commit reachable from it keep their signatures; rule 5 judges every other commit a branch adds. null: not cut over, nothing refused under rule 5.
